**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, term-termination).**

- **Where:** Article IV TERM (p0049) — 36-month Initial Period, then *"The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor."*
- **Problem:** A seven-year extension exercisable unilaterally by Licensor, with no Licensee consent, no non-renewal notice window, and no cap on renewal fees. That is a walk-away item under RENEWAL (automatic/one-sided multi-year renewals), and it contradicts clauses II and III of the same Article, which already contemplate extension only by mutual written agreement.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** renewal only by mutual written agreement in successive 12-month increments; Licensor must give 60 days' notice of any proposed renewal and fee change; renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
- **Fallback offered in the comment:** 12-month automatic renewals we may exit on 30 days' notice with uplift capped at 5%.
